license_note: The qwen3.5-plus-2026-04-20 snapshot is served as a Model Studio API model under the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Service Agreement, effective September 2, 2026, which Model Studio's related-agreements page lists as governing the service. It is a paid-service contract that bars reselling the service or its models and using them or their outputs to train or develop competing products without written permission, and prohibits reverse engineering or trying to discover the service's source code. It grants no licence to model weights for redistribution or self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Business and developer access to the qwen3.5-plus-2026-04-20 snapshot through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API services

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen3.5-Plus line at its newest dated snapshot, qwen3.5-plus-2026-04-20, which Alibaba Cloud Model Studio serves in its Singapore and Beijing regions with text, image, and video input and 1M context. The undated qwen3.5-plus model still resolves to the February 15, 2026 snapshot, which this record does not cover. That snapshot, the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B open weights that Alibaba calls Qwen3.5-Plus's open counterpart, the Qwen3.5-Flash line, later Qwen generations, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Alibaba documents the dated snapshot with its own capability, context-limit, and pricing tables and names its agentic-coding and speed gains over the February 15 snapshot
Text, image, and video input with 1M context, function calling, structured output, web search, and context caching
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist under the Qwen3.5-Plus name; the corresponding Qwen3.5-397B-A17B open weights are a separate release that Alibaba says lacks hosted production features such as the 1M default context and built-in tools
Served only in the Singapore and Beijing regions while the undated qwen3.5-plus name still resolves to the February snapshot, and dated snapshots get 30 days' retirement notice
